description: This file defines the MathTrig class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation namespace, consisting of deprecated static methods that wrap calls to specific mathematical functions and classes. It serves as a collection of mathematical functions historically used in spreadsheet calculations, but now redirects to specialized classes. The file contains references to external classes and methods related to mathematical computation and Excel function implementations.

classes.name: MathTrig
classes.description: A deprecated class providing static methods that act as wrappers for various mathematical functions used in spreadsheet calculations. These methods are mainly wrappers redirecting calls to specific specialized classes handling individual functions, aiding backward compatibility within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: ARABIC
